app.name: REMS-desk
app.tagline: Office equipment repair, maintenance & replacement tracking

landing.hero_subtitle: Automate servicing of printers, copiers, computers and other office equipment. Transparency, control, efficiency.
landing.features_title: Everything you need for equipment management
landing.features_subtitle: A comprehensive solution for managing repair and maintenance requests
landing.f1_desc: Centralised logging of all issues with printers, MFPs, computers and other office equipment.
landing.f2_desc: Monitor work progress in real time from request submission to closure.
landing.f3_desc: Maintain an asset registry with service history, warranty dates and specifications.
landing.f4_desc: Role separation: owner and employees. Task assignment and progress tracking inside the organisation.
landing.f5_desc: Instant alerts on status changes, technician assignments and completed work.
landing.f6_desc: Statistics on requests, completion times, workload and equipment health.
landing.roles_subtitle: REMS supports different access levels within a single organisation
landing.role_owner_desc: Creates the organisation, adds staff, oversees all requests and sees full statistics.
landing.role_manager_desc: Accepts and assigns requests to technicians, monitors deadlines.
landing.role_tech_desc: Receives tasks, records completed work and comments on repair progress.
landing.role_emp_desc: Submits repair requests for their equipment and tracks request status.
landing.flow_title: From request to closure — three steps
landing.flow_subtitle: A simple, clear process for all participants
landing.flow1_desc: Describes the fault, specifies the equipment and attaches photos if needed.
landing.flow2_desc: The request enters the queue; the manager assesses priority and assigns a specialist.
landing.flow3_desc: The specialist records the outcome; the employee receives a closure notification.
landing.guide_section_sub: REMS works equally well for managing repairs within a single company and for collaboration between two organisations.
landing.guideA1_desc: Signs up as Owner — the system creates the organisation and provides a unique ID.
landing.guideA2_desc: Employees sign up with the org ID. The owner approves join requests.
landing.guideA3_desc: One employee files a request → another picks it up and closes it after the repair. The owner sees the whole flow.
landing.guideB_tag: Client and contractor in one system
landing.guideB1_desc: Your company (client) and your service partner (contractor) create separate organisations in REMS.
landing.guideB2_desc: The contractor becomes your service partner — you get a single channel for submitting repair requests.
landing.guideB3_desc: Your staff create requests → contractor's employees pick them up → you track every stage in real time.
landing.statuses_subtitle: Every request follows a clear path from submission to closure
landing.status_new_desc: The request has been submitted by an employee and is awaiting acceptance.
landing.status_accepted_desc: The request has been accepted; priority and timing have been assessed.
landing.status_inprogress_desc: The assignee is carrying out repair or diagnosis of the equipment.
landing.status_done_desc: The assignee has recorded the result and is awaiting confirmation.
landing.status_closed_desc: The request is closed. All work has been completed and confirmed.
landing.cta_subtitle: Join organisations already using REMS for maintenance management.
landing.footer: © 2026 REMS-desk — Office Equipment Repair Request Management System

consent.pdn_title: Consent to the processing of personal data
consent.pdn_body:
By creating an account, I give my informed, specific, and freely-given consent to REMS-desk (the operator / data controller) processing my personal data, in accordance with the GDPR (Articles 6(1)(a) and 7), Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ "On Personal Data" (Article 9), and applicable US privacy laws.

Data covered: name; email and/or phone; organisation and role; and data generated while using the Service (requests, comments, ratings, attachments).

Purposes: registration and identification; access to the Service; processing equipment service and repair requests; and sending verification codes and notifications.

Processing operations: collection, recording, structuring, storage, use, disclosure within my organisation, restriction, erasure, and anonymisation, by automated and non-automated means. Personal data of Russian citizens is, where required, stored in Russia (Law 242-FZ).

Legal basis & withdrawal: this consent is the legal basis where consent is required and is valid until withdrawn. I can withdraw it at any time at support@rems-desk.ru without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal; afterwards my account and related data are deleted, except records that must be retained by law.

My rights: access, rectification/correction, erasure, restriction/blocking, portability, and objection; EU/EEA — complaint to a supervisory authority, Russia — complaint to Roskomnadzor, California — CCPA rights. See the Privacy Policy for details.
consent.privacy_body:
This Privacy Policy explains how REMS-desk (the "Service"; operator and data controller: the REMS-desk administration) collects, uses, and protects personal data. It is written to align with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ "On Personal Data" (and EAEU rules), and applicable US privacy laws (including the CCPA/CPRA).

1. Data we collect: account and contact details (name, email, phone), organisation and role, and data you generate using the Service (requests, attachments, comments, ratings, status history); technical data — device identifier, session and security logs.

2. Purposes & legal bases (GDPR Art. 6; Arts. 6 and 9 of 152-FZ): providing the Service and authentication (performance of a contract); sending verification codes and security notifications (legitimate interest / contract); compliance with legal obligations; and, where required, your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.

3. How we use data: solely to operate the Service — authentication, isolating each organisation's data, processing requests, and notifications. We do not sell or share your data for advertising, and we do not use automated decision-making producing legal effects.

4. Sharing: data is accessible within your organisation according to your role. We use processors (our hosting provider and the email provider that delivers verification codes) bound by data-processing terms.

5. International transfers & localisation: where data is processed outside your country, we rely on appropriate safeguards (e.g., EU Standard Contractual Clauses). Personal data of Russian citizens is, where required, recorded and stored in databases located in Russia (Law 242-FZ).

6. Retention: data is kept while your account is active; media files of closed requests are deleted after the period set by your organisation; backups and legally required records are kept for limited statutory periods.

7. Security: passwords and PINs are stored as irreversible hashes; access between organisations is isolated at the database level (row-level security); transport uses encrypted connections.

8. Your rights: GDPR (EU/EEA) — access, rectification, erasure ("right to be forgotten"), restriction, portability, objection, withdrawal of consent, and a complaint to a supervisory authority; Russia (152-FZ) — access, correction, blocking, deletion and withdrawal of consent, and a complaint to Roskomnadzor; US (California, CCPA/CPRA) — know, delete, and correct your data and opt out of its "sale"/"sharing" (we do neither), without discrimination for exercising these rights.

9. Contact: to exercise any right or ask questions, contact support@rems-desk.ru. We respond within legally required timeframes (generally up to 30 days under GDPR, 45 days under the CCPA, and the periods set by 152-FZ).
